tweet.text: We caution that MALT only contains a small number of natural examples of concerning behaviors, and with low diversity (e.g. there are no severe examples of sandbagging), while the prompted examples may lack realism. While we don’t think good performance on MALT alone is necessary or sufficient to detect real-world risks, we’re excited for MALT to serve as a piece of evidence of the overall picture.
